evals.name: check-reports-layers-references-and-collectors-without-writing
evals.expected_output: Runs the bundled setup-check.sh and presents its table: the interpreter row, each configuration layer as absent or parsed, the tracked-file guard on the team file, every reference with the layer that supplied it, and one row per collector adapter with a version or missing plus its install hint. Writes nothing and installs nothing.
expectations: Invokes the skill's scripts/setup-check.sh rather than inspecting files by hand
Presents a row per collector adapter, naming missing ones with their install hint and calling them optional
Presents each reference with the layer that supplied it
Does not install any tool and does not write any file

evals.name: apply-with-complete-arguments-is-non-interactive-and-idempotent
evals.expected_output: Runs check, then setup-apply.py once with both key=value arguments against the repository root, re-runs check, and reports the persisted values from the table with the tracked-file pair result: written but untracked means commit it, never success. Asks no questions because the arguments were complete.
expectations: Asks no interview questions when complete key=value arguments are given
Calls setup-apply.py with the repository root and the given key=value pairs in one invocation
Re-runs check and reports the values from its table, not from the write alone
States that the untracked team file must be committed to reach the team

evals.name: apply-without-arguments-interviews-one-key-at-a-time-and-never-touches-gitignore
evals.expected_output: Runs check, then interviews one key at a time with a recommendation first (the cyclomatic reference with its ISO citation and the two alternatives, the file-length reference with its plugin-default label, exclusions, lanes), preserves keys the existing file carries, writes only the team file, and recommends the .claude/**/*.local.* ignore line without editing .gitignore.
expectations: Interviews one key at a time, leading with a recommendation and its provenance
Preserves keys already present in the existing team file
Recommends the recursive .claude/**/*.local.* line rather than editing .gitignore
Writes only .claude/code-metrics.yaml, never the user-global or local layers
